original_value: Samsung 860 EVO solid state drive is the SSD to trust. Based on 3D VNAND flash, Samsung offers enhanced read/write performance, endurance and power management efficiency. With multiple form factors, the 860 EVO is ideal for mainstream PCs and laptops. Cache Memory - Samsung 512 MB Low Power DDR4 SDRAMPowered by Samsung V NAND Technology; Optimized Performance for Everyday Computing. Enhanced Performance: Sequential Read/Write speeds up to 550MB/s and 520MB/s respectively;Reliability: 1.5 Mil
